note: 2022 picks anchored on Spotify Wrapped Indonesia 2022 top songs; 2023 top local song per Spotify Wrapped 2023.

Spotify Wrapped 2020 top 5 overall and top 5 local confirmed (Bandwagon, Jakarta Post). Google Year in Search 2020 'Lirik Lagu' adds Lathi, Cuek and Menghapus Jejakmu. Javanese pop: Los Dol (Google says it was among YouTube's top trending videos of 2020). No 2020-specific ranked source was found for Didi Kempot (died May 2020), Ndarboy Genk or Happy Asmara songs. Red Velvet 'Psycho' is a 23 Dec 2019 release counted in 2020.

Spotify Wrapped 2021 gave only an overall top 5 (Bandwagon); JOOX 2021 top 5, Google Year in Search 2021, YouTube Indonesia 2021 trending and TikTok's 2021 playlist add depth. Javanese/dangdut: Widodari (Google #2), Satru and Angel (YouTube top trending, unranked), Bawa Aku Ke Penghulu (Google #5). YouTube's own 2021 music top 10 was not retrievable.

Well evidenced: Spotify Wrapped 2022 top 10 (Bandwagon), Billboard Indonesia Songs number-ones, Google Year in Search 2022 and YouTube Indonesia 2022 top music videos all agree on Hati-Hati di Jalan and Tak Ingin Usai. Dangdut/Javanese hits of the year: Ojo Dibandingke (Farel Prayoga's version; original by Abah Lala), Joko Tingkir Ngombe Dawet, Madiun Ngawi, Satru 2. Mahalini 'Sisa Rasa' may be a late-2021 release that peaked in 2022.

No full Spotify Wrapped 2023 Indonesia song list was found; Spotify named only #1 local song (Tak Segampang Itu) and top ambyar song (Nemen). Ranking leans on Billboard Indonesia Songs number-one runs, Google Year in Search 2023 and Medcom's viral roundup. YouTube's 2023 Indonesia music top 10 was not found. Tak Segampang Itu (2 Dec 2022), Komang and Satu-Satu are 2022 releases whose peak was 2023. Javanese/dangdut is thin (Nemen, Kalih Welasku).

Spotify Indonesia 2024 top 10 (detikPop, citing Spotify data), Spotify Wrapped Live 2024 winners, YouTube Indonesia 2024 Lagu Teratas and Shorts lists, Google Year in Search 2024 and Billboard number-ones. Javanese: Guyon Waton 'Wirang' (Spotify top ambyar song 2024). Shorts carried eastern-Indonesian party tracks (Dola, Faja Skali) and Nella Kharisma 'Sebelas Duabelas'. Penjaga Hati (Jun 2023) peaked across both years.

Spotify Wrapped 2025 gave the top 5 local songs (iNews), #1 international song (NIKI, an Indonesian artist Spotify files as international) and #1 ambyar song. Mangu was the most-streamed track overall. Billboard/ASIRI number-ones, Google Year in Search 2025 and a GoodStats Oct 2025 snapshot of YouTube's Indonesia chart add depth. Tabola Bale and Pica Pica are eastern-Indonesian (NTT) party hits that YouTube carried. The YouTube evidence is a snapshot, not an official year-end list. Kompas's 2025 viral kaleidoscope could not be fetched.
Weekly number ones in the order they first led the chart, read from Wikipedia's list page and checked against it. Where each artist is from is not recorded yet, so these count as heard there only.
